paraphrase: A submission must be the final version: all metadata present, every link working, no placeholder text or temporary content, tested on a device, and with a demo account or approved demo mode if the app has a login. Bundles that are incomplete or crash are rejected. Any in-app purchases must be complete and visible to the reviewer, or explained in the review notes.
quote: placeholder text, empty websites, and other temporary content should be scrubbed before submission
